screening_decisions.reason: Randomized controlled trial in women with stress (USI/SUI); PFMT arms (with/without biofeedback) compared against a no-exercise control.
Randomized controlled trial in women with SUI; PFMT delivered via mobile app vs postponed/no-treatment control.
Randomized controlled trial in postmenopausal women with SUI; PFME alone and PFME+biofeedback vs a non-treated control.

Randomized placebo-controlled trial in older women with UUI/MUI; behavioral arm (biofeedback-assisted behavioral treatment, which typically includes PFMT) vs drug and placebo control; placebo provides inactive comparator. PFMT component not fully explicit but probable.
Randomized controlled trial in older women with sphincteric incontinence (stress-type); PFMT and biofeedback vs control (no treatment).
Single-blind randomized controlled trial in women with urodynamically confirmed genuine SUI; PFMT vs no treatment (inactive control), plus other active comparators.
Randomized study in women with SUI; perineal (pelvic floor) exercises vs control (no treatment).
Single-blind RCT in women with urodynamic SUI; PFMT vs no active treatment (inactive control).
Prospective randomized controlled trial in women with stress and mixed UI; PFMT vs control.
Randomized controlled trial of a group Behavioral Modification Program vs no treatment in incontinent women; program likely included PFMT (pelvic muscle strength improved). Included conservatively.
Randomized crossover trial in elderly women with SUI; exercise class aimed at PFMs and fitness vs control (no exercise).
Randomized trial in elderly women with stress/urge/mixed UI; exercise groups (including PFMT) vs education-only inactive control.
Randomized controlled trial in elderly women with stress/urge/mixed UI; multidimensional exercise treatment (including PFMT) vs control (no significant improvement reported).
Randomized controlled trial; standardized physiotherapy program with PFMT vs advice/education only (inactive control).
Randomized trial in women with SUI; supervised PFMT vs no treatment control.

Randomized single-blind study in older women with mild–moderate SUI; instruction in pelvic floor pre-contraction ('The Knack') vs wait-list/no-treatment control. Considered PFMT-related behavioral training.
Randomized controlled pilot study in women with SUI; PFMT (group or individual) vs no-treatment control.
Randomized pilot in women with MUI; PFMT vs waiting list (no treatment) control (third arm acupuncture).
Randomized controlled trial in postmenopausal women with UI; physical therapy for UI (likely including PFMT) vs osteoporosis education control (inactive with respect to UI).
Comparative trial with PFMT, bladder training, and a control group; PFMT vs control (randomization not explicit). Included conservatively.
Randomized experimental study in women with SUI; kinesitherapy (pelvic floor exercises) vs control (no treatment), with/without electrical stimulation.
Randomized study in female volleyball athletes with SUI; pelvic floor muscle rehabilitation program vs pamphlet-only control (inactive).
Random allocation in women with genuine SUI; PFMT vs interferential/eostrogen vs control; includes no-treatment control.
Randomized controlled trial in general practice; PFMT vs no therapy control in women with genuine SUI.
Randomized clinical trial; PFMT vs untreated control in women with stress or mixed UI.
Randomized controlled trial in long-term care facilities; program including Kegel’s (PFMT) vs control; UI outcomes assessed.
Randomized controlled trial in women with UI; behavioral therapy vs no therapy control. Behavioral therapy likely included PFMT; included conservatively.
Randomized controlled trial; co-contraction exercise (includes PFMT) vs control (no exercises) in women with SUI.
Randomized controlled trial in obese perimenopausal women with SUI; PFMT vs control (no treatment).
Randomized study in women with SUI; exercises (PFMT) ± electrotherapy vs control (no treatment).
Blinded, doubly controlled RCT in women with SUI; PFMT alone and combined PFMT+drug arms vs a 'no active treatment' arm (inactive control).
Randomized comparison of physical therapy modalities in female SUI; no inactive control arm described.
Pragmatic RCT of nurse specialist involvement vs usual care; not a PFMT vs inactive-control design.
Satisfaction study alongside an intervention; not a randomized trial of PFMT vs inactive control.
Urge incontinence RCT with behavioral arms (with/without biofeedback) and a self-help booklet; no inactive (no-treatment/placebo/sham) control.
Feasibility study; not randomized and no inactive control group.
PFMT supervised vs unsupervised; no no-treatment/placebo/sham control.
PFM-focused stabilization vs routine physiotherapy (active comparator); no inactive control.
Stress incontinence RCT; behavioral training ± PFES vs self-help booklet (active), not an inactive control.
Economic evaluation alongside RCT comparing two active PFMT delivery modes; no randomized no-treatment arm.
Internet vs postal PFMT RCT; no inactive comparator.
Long-term follow-up of Internet vs postal PFMT; no inactive comparator.
Pilot RCT combining behavioral UI strategies with physical activity; PFMT not explicitly part of the intervention.
PFMT program in gynecologic cancer survivors with pelvic floor dysfunction; population not defined as SUI/UUI/MUI.
